metadata.description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains the current German modern-LaTeX source control; cumulative English, Spanish, French, and Interslavic working readers; bounded components in additional languages; and editable source, provenance, repair, render, and audit material.

Current bounded additions: Paper 2 printed pp. 58-90 plus table leaves 91-92 are closed at the best-available source-critical current-head level, with leaves 93-96 retained only as boundary controls; printed pp. 23-57 remain open. Paper 4 sections 6-7 receive six print-confirmed German source-control repairs. The five mathematical section-7 repairs survive in Latin Interslavic, Cyrillic Interslavic, Russian, and Ukrainian targets. A separate bounded English Paper 4 section-7 checkpoint covers R823 lines 4112-4268 / printed pp. 141-146 and continues at section 8, line 4270.

Machine-readable evidence: the evidence archives retain structural indices, source/formula/table comparisons, terminology and adverse-choice records, append-only difficulty/failure and decision records, exact source/control hashes, build receipts, validation history, and public projection receipts. One internal workflow phrase in the producer English-section-7 package is replaced by audience-neutral wording and explicitly receipted; its translation, TeX, PDF, renders, and evidence ledgers are unchanged.

Visual evidence: 132 visuals are indexed. Fifty-three exact project-generated output renders are published with dimensions, DPI where available, rotation, parent-document hash, output page, linked structural unit, review output, and QA disposition. Seventy-nine original-print-derived pages/crops are represented by hashes and metadata only because redistribution rights are unresolved; no source pixels are silently included.

Status caveat: these are substantial machine-assisted working editions, translations, source controls, and review artifacts. Bounded source-audit claims apply only to their stated units. They are not complete Paper 2 or Paper 4 editions, an official critical edition, peer review, proof certification, independent human scholarly review, accessibility certification, native-language/community certification, a rights determination, or a guarantee that every symbol and translation choice is correct.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: Reader-first multilingual Noether working corpus. This version advances bounded Paper 2 source control through printed pp. 58-92, repairs German Paper 4 sections 6-7, propagates the mathematical section-7 corrections to four Slavic/Interslavic targets, and adds a source-audited English section-7 unit. The rights-aware visual package publishes 53 project renders and represents 79 source-derived rasters by metadata only. Paper 2 pp. 23-57 and Paper 4 section 8 onward remain open. Not complete papers, a critical edition, peer review, proof certification, independent human/native review, accessibility certification, or rights clearance.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
